eval: (() => { const g = game, C = g.CONFIG || null; const B = g.ballistics, V = g.player.position.constructor; window.__drop = (dist) => { const o = new V(0, 200, 0); const d = new V(0, 0, 1); B.fire(o, d); let t = 0, x = null; const H = g.hunting; for (let i = 0; i < 2000 && x === null; i++) { const dt = 1 / 120; t += dt; B.update(dt, (from, dir, maxT, travelled) => { if (travelled + maxT >= dist) { const k = dist - travelled; x = { queda: +(from.y + dir.y * k - 200).toFixed(2), tempo: +t.toFixed(3) }; return true; } return false; }); } return x; }; return { m50: __drop(50), m100: __drop(100), m200: __drop(200), m300: __drop(300), m400: __drop(400) }; })()
label: queda da bala (m) e tempo de voo (s) por distância

eval: (() => { const g = game, p = g.player, V = p.position.constructor; const B = g.ballistics, H = g.hunting; const res = {}; for (const dist of [50, 150, 300]) { const o = new V(p.position.x, p.position.y + 1.7, p.position.z); const alvo = new V(o.x + Math.sin(1.0) * -dist, o.y, o.z + Math.cos(1.0) * -dist); const dir = new V(alvo.x - o.x, 0, alvo.z - o.z).normalize(); H.lastShot = null; B.fire(o, dir); let passou = null; for (let i = 0; i < 3000 && passou === null; i++) { B.update(1 / 240, (from, d2, maxT, travelled) => { if (travelled + maxT >= dist) { const k = dist - travelled; passou = +(from.y + d2.y * k - o.y).toFixed(2); return true; } return false; }); } res['alvo a ' + dist + ' m'] = { alturaDaBalaRelativaAMira: passou }; } return res; })()
